name: Browse nationwide U.S. properties
description: Verifies the marketplace displays U.S.-only listings and supports property type and location search.
expected: U.S. property results are shown and the Austin tiny home remains visible.

name: Customer registration and login controls
description: Verifies visitors can access customer authentication.

name: Owner property management
description: Verifies the owner can add, edit, publish, hide and delete listings.
expected: Property changes persist and public listings refresh.

name: Persistent property enquiry
description: Verifies a customer enquiry is stored for owner follow-up.
steps: Enter contact details and a message
expected: The enquiry is stored and visible to the owner.

name: Mobile marketplace
description: Verifies the marketplace remains usable on a phone.
expected: Results and property details are usable without horizontal overflow.
